function.description: Read the saved body of a prior tool result that was truncated or compacted in the conversation, one page at a time, by tool_call_id. Use only when the retained part is insufficient; pass the offset named in the truncation marker to read further.
function.name: tool_result_read

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from (default 0). Use the offset named in the truncation marker to continue.

tool_call_id.description: The tool_call_id shown in the compacted tool result placeholder.
